arxiv-2012-09508.title: Towards Optimal District Heating Temperature Control in China with Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2012-09508.creator: Adrien Le Coz, Tahar Nabil, François Courtot
arxiv-2012-09508.description: Abstract Achieving efficiency gains in Chinese district heating networks, thereby reducing their carbon footprint, requires new optimal control methods going beyond current industry tools. Focusing on the secondary network, we propose a data-driven deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approach to address this task. We build a recurrent neural network, trained on simulated data, to predict the indoor temperatures.

arxiv-2104-02484.title: OodGAN: Generative Adversarial Network for Out-of-Domain Data Generation
arxiv-2104-02484.creator: Petr Marek, Vishal Ishwar Naik, Vincent Auvray, Anuj Goyal
arxiv-2104-02484.description: Abstract Detecting an Out-of-Domain (OOD) utterance is crucial for a robust dialog system. Most dialog systems are trained on a pool of annotated OOD data to achieve this goal. However, collecting the annotated OOD data for a given domain is an expensive process.

arxiv-2104-07968.title: Zero-cycle groups on algebraic varieties
arxiv-2104-07968.creator: Federico Binda and Amalendu Krishna
arxiv-2104-07968.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Federico Binda and Amalendu Krishna. We compare various groups of 0-cycles on quasi-projective varieties over a field. As applications, we show that for certain singular projective varieties, the Levine-Weibel Chow group of 0-cycles coincides with the corresponding Friedlander-Voevodsky motivic cohomology. We also show that over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, the Chow group of 0-cycles with modulus on a smooth projective variety with respect to a reduced divisor coincides with the Suslin homology of the complement of the divisor.

arxiv-2106-12564.title: Epicyclic frequencies in static and spherically symmetric wormhole geometries
arxiv-2106-12564.creator: Vittorio De Falco 1,2, Mariafelicia De Laurentis 3,2,4, Salvatore Capozziello 2,3,4,5
arxiv-2106-12564.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vittorio De Falco 1,2, Mariafelicia De Laurentis 3,2,4, Salvatore Capozziello 2,3,4,5. The measurement of the epicyclic frequencies is a widely used astrophysical technique to infer information on a given self-gravitating system and on the related gravity background. We derive their explicit expressions in static and spherically symmetric wormhole spacetimes.

arxiv-2201-05689.title: New fixed point theorems for ( ϕ , F ) − (\phi,F)- contraction on rectangular b-metric spaces
arxiv-2201-05689.creator: Mohamed Rossafi 1∗ and Abdelkarim Kari 2
arxiv-2201-05689.description: Abstract . The Banach contraction principle is the most celebrated fixed point theorem, it has been generalized in various directions. In this paper, inspired by the concept of ( ϕ , F ) − (\phi,F)- contraction in metric spaces, introduced by Wardowski.

arxiv-2208-14196.title: A Unified Primal-Dual Algorithm Framework for Inequality Constrained Problems
arxiv-2208-14196.creator: Zhenyuan Zhu, Fan Chen, Junyu Zhang, Zaiwen Wen
arxiv-2208-14196.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhenyuan Zhu, Fan Chen, Junyu Zhang, Zaiwen Wen. In this paper, we propose a unified primal-dual algorithm framework based on the augmented Lagrangian function for composite convex problems with conic inequality constraints. The new framework is highly versatile. First, it not only covers many existing algorithms such as PDHG, Chambolle-Pock (CP), GDA, OGDA and linearized ALM, but also guides us to design a new efficient algorithm called Simi-OGDA (SOGDA).

arxiv-2309-02119.title: Hierarchical Masked 3D Diffusion Model for Video Outpainting Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’23), October 29-November 3, 2023, Ottaw
arxiv-2309-02119.creator: Fanda Fan, Chaoxu Guo, Litong Gong, Biao Wang, Tiezheng Ge, Yuning Jiang, Chunjie Luo, Jianfeng Zhan
arxiv-2309-02119.description: Abstract . Video outpainting aims to adequately complete missing areas at the edges of video frames. Compared to image outpainting, it presents an additional challenge as the model should maintain the temporal consistency of the filled area. In this paper, we introduce a masked 3D diffusion model for video outpainting.

arxiv-2410-00022.title: TREB: a BERT attempt for imputing tabular data imputation
arxiv-2410-00022.creator: Shuyue Wang, Wenjun Zhou, Han drk-m-s Jiang, Shuo Wang, Ren Zheng
arxiv-2410-00022.description: Abstract TREB, a novel tabular imputation framework utilizing BERT, introduces a groundbreaking approach for handling missing values in tabular data. Unlike traditional methods that often overlook the specific demands of imputation, TREB leverages the robust capabilities of BERT to address this critical task. While many BERT-based approaches for tabular data have emerged, they frequently under-utilize the language model’s full potential.

arxiv-2503-23583.title: Magnetoelectric initialisation of multiferroic Mn 2 GeO 4
arxiv-2503-23583.creator: Naëmi Leo ∗, Jonathan S. White, Michel Kenzelmann, Takashi Honda, Tsuyoshi Kimura, Dennis Meier, Manfred Fiebig
arxiv-2503-23583.description: Abstract Magnetoelectric multiferroics promise direct cross-control between coexisting ferroelectric and ferromagnetic orders, which is of interest for applications in magnetism and spintronics. A particularly interesting type of cross-control is found in spin-spiral multiferroic Mn 2 GeO 4 , where a ferroelectric multi-domain distribution can be globally inverted by a single magnetic field sweep.

arxiv-2504-01997.title: Semantic SLAM with Rolling-Shutter Cameras and Low-Precision INS in Outdoor Environments
arxiv-2504-01997.creator: Yuchen Zhang, Miao Fan, Shengtong Xu, Xiangzeng Liu, Haoyi Xiong
arxiv-2504-01997.description: Abstract Accurate localization and mapping in outdoor environments remains challenging when using consumer-grade hardware, particularly with rolling-shutter cameras and low-precision inertial navigation systems (INS). We present a novel semantic SLAM approach that leverages road elements such as lane boundaries, traffic signs, and road markings to enhance localization accuracy.

arxiv-2510-22702.title: Atlas Urban Index: A VLM-Based Approach for Spatially and Temporally Calibrated Urban Development Monitoring
arxiv-2510-22702.creator: Mithul ChanderPropheus mithul@propheus.com, Sai Pragnya RangaPropheus saipragnyaranga@gmail.com Prathamesh MayekarPropheus prathamesh@propheus.com
arxiv-2510-22702.description: Abstract We introduce the Atlas Urban Index (AUI), a metric for measuring urban development computed using Sentinel-2 ( spoto2012sentinel2 ) satellite imagery. Existing approaches, such as the Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI), often struggle to accurately capture urban development due to factors like atmospheric noise, seasonal variation, and cloud cover. These limitations hinder large-scale monitoring of human development and urbanization.

pmc-11338879.title: Real-time fluorescent multiple cross displacement amplification for rapid and sensitive Mycoplasma pneumoniae detection
pmc-11338879.creator: Fei Xiao, Yu Zhang, Wenjian Xu, Jin Fu, Xiaolan Huang, Nan Jia, Chunrong Sun, Zheng Xu, Baoying Zheng, Juan Zhou, Yi Wang, Lihui Meng
pmc-11338879.description: Mycoplasma pneumoniae is a significant pathogen responsible for community-acquired pneumonia, predominantly affecting children and adolescents. Here, we devised a rapid method for M. pneumoniae that combined multiple cross displacement amplification (MCDA) with real-time fluorescence technology. A set of ten primers, which were specifically designed for M. pneumoniae detection, were employed in a real-time fluorescence MCDA reaction.

pmc-11395993.title: “I’m trying to take the lead from my child”: experiences Parenting Young Nonbinary Children
pmc-11395993.creator: Noah Sweder, Lucinda Garcia, Fernando Salinas-Quiroz
pmc-11395993.description: BackgroundWhile research has emphasized the importance of parental support for LGBTQIA + youth wellbeing, there remains limited understanding of parental experiences with nonbinary children, particularly those prepubescent. This study aimed to explore how parents of nonbinary children ages 5–8 learn to support their child’s identity, examining initial reactions, emotional processes, supportive behaviors, societal responses, and associated challenges and rewards.

pmc-11583123.title: Linker Chemistry and Connectivity Fine-Tune the Immune Response and Kinetic Solubility of Conjugated NOD2/TLR7 Agonists
pmc-11583123.creator: Špela Janež, Samo Guzelj, Žiga Jakopin
pmc-11583123.description: There is a growing interest in developing novel immune potentiators capable of eliciting a cellular immune response. We tackle this challenge by harnessing the synergistic cross-activation between two innate immune receptors—the nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-containing protein 2 (NOD2) and Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7).

pmc-12609167.title: Primary gallbladder paraganglioma: a case report
pmc-12609167.creator: Sarah Mawlaalduwilah, Abdulrahman Alammar, Abdullah Alsoghair, Ibrahim Al-babtain
pmc-12609167.description: Paragangliomas are rare neuroendocrine neoplasms arising from neural crest cells. Among these, primary gallbladder paragangliomas are extremely rare and are typically discovered incidentally during cholecystectomy. This case report describes a 37-year-old female presenting with biliary colic, who underwent laparoscopic cholecystectomy, which revealed a microscopic focus of paraganglioma. Immunohistochemical findings confirmed its benign, parasympathetic nature.

pmc-12663039.title: Successful treatment of refractory erosive lichen planus with abrocitinib: A case report
pmc-12663039.creator: Valerie Hladky, Deana Funaro, Rosalie-Sélène Meunier, Alexandra Mereniuk, Alexandre Lemieux
pmc-12663039.description: Erosive lichen planus is a rare, chronic, immune-mediated inflammatory disease that can lead to significant morbidity. Erosive lichen planus is often resistant to therapies, and spontaneous remission is uncommon. We report the case of a 62-year-old woman with severe and refractory erosive lichen planus involving the oral, genital, and esophageal mucosa, who failed multiple systemic treatments.

pmc-12974449.title: Topography influences megadune distribution and morphology
pmc-12974449.creator: Hui Zhao, Keqi Wang, Yongwei Sheng, Deguo Zhang, Clément Narteau, Shengan Zhan, Fahu Chen
pmc-12974449.description: SignificanceGlobal megadune distributions remain poorly characterized, with their formation mechanisms still debated. This study summarizes megadune distribution patterns at a global scale and finds that megadunes have distinct formation mechanisms and dynamic behaviors compared to normal-sized dunes. Simulation results reveal that both positive (mountain-like) and negative (basin-shaped) topographies induce abrupt shear stress gradients, which trigger rapid localized sand accumulation.

pmc-13537232.title: The larval Drosophila mushroom body balances lateralized sensing and interhemispheric integration
pmc-13537232.creator: David M. Zimmerman, Benjamin L. de Bivort, Aravinthan D. T. Samuel
pmc-13537232.description: Bilaterian animals must integrate sensory input from both sides of their bodies to make coherent perceptual decisions. In Drosophila larvae, olfactory receptor neurons target the ipsilateral brain hemisphere. Using calcium imaging, unilateral sensory perturbations, connectome analysis, and optogenetics, we identified the mushroom body (MB) as a key substrate for interhemispheric integration.

pmc-13653327.creator: Parimal Majumder, Joshua Lee, Royce Butler, Christopher D. Scharer, Jeremy M. Boss
pmc-13653327.description: SUMMARYMHC-II gene expression requires promoter-proximal and distal organizing elements. A super enhancer located between the HLA-DR and -DQ genes was dissected into five microdomains (regions A-E) to define its mechanism of action. Regions A and B were required for maximal expression of HLA-DQA1.
